name: resq
description: Read ResQ records and, with explicit write consent and account permissions, create and accept work orders, manage appointments, and start visits.

interface.longDescription: Connect facility and service-provider teams to ResQ in ChatGPT and Codex. Read authorized facilities, equipment, work orders, invoices, attachments, and visits. With explicit write consent and existing account permissions, create and accept work orders, schedule or reschedule appointments, return appointments to scheduling, and start visits. Available tools depend on the selected organization, permissions, and consent. Read-only access remains available. Media upload, attachment creation, and invoice submission are not supported. ResQ OAuth starts when you connect.
defaultPrompt: Show me the facilities and work orders I can access in ResQ.
